text_block_list.text:
(… That day, during practice with Ardan-san,
it felt like she was using her lead to
restrain me… up against that, I—)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: (… lost my balance on purpose.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
…I'm sorry,
Ardan-san.
I'll work hard so I can dance with you
properly.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(But please,
forgive me for that time. I was so scared.
If you'd gone any further, I—)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(— I thought I'd lose that "special" I'd
worked so hard for.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: You copying Maruzen's dance?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text: Eh-?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Hey hey,
can I share this studio with you? It's OK,
right?
I just wanna work on the finishing touches
of my routine!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Ah, okay!… Wait how'd you know?!
That I was trying to copy Maruzen-san's dance,
I mean…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
That's 'cause I studied Prez's dance from
head to toe, duh!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
So I wanna shine super bright just like Prez
did at the Dorowa! Like this!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
(And so Teio-san began to dance,
with every step looking just like—)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: (Just… like…?)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
W… what are you doing with the choreography?!
Isn't that completely different from what
Rudolf-san did?!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Yup. It's so "Teio", no?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah,
I'm sorry!
You said "like the president," so I thought
you'd just do the exact same dance…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Huuuuh? 'Course not!
I'm the "Monarch" who'll beat the "Emperor",
y'know!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Plus,
there's no point if I just do a carbon copy
of Prez!
If Prez herself competes in the Dorowa,
a cheap copy won't win against her,
now would it?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
All a copy can do is take you to a draw.
To win,
I've gotta put on a show like nobody else!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
You don't wanna win,
Chiyono O?
Even if Maruzen joined the Dorowa?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Mwehehe! I mean,
you're aiming for Best Date too,
aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text: …All a copy can do is take you to a draw.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
But the "ordinary" old me can't help wanting
to be "special",
even if that means just copying someone
else…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
You don't wanna win,
Chiyono O?
Even if Maruzen joined the Dorowa?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text: …gh!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(… There's a reason I couldn't synchronise
with Chiyono O-san during our practice at
the studio.)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
(I know why. A dance takes two,
but… on that day…)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Our eyes never met, not even once.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
(… I knew she was practicing on her own
behind my back.
She didn't want to burden me with worry.
Even so—)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: …Don't just look at "them."
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Ah… uh,
Ardan-san? Would you like a drink?
They say a warm drink's the best when you're
feelin' down and out, yeah?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: …Nature-san. Thank you for your concern.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
…You're not really practising together,
is it? About that,
Chiyono-san's been practising on her own
for a while…
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
So you've been worried for her as well.
I'm sorry to have troubled you.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
If I may confess,
the time we have to practise together is
rather linited.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
It's the fault of my weak legs.
Even just continuing to practise for too
long leads to a temperature… despite that
constraint, we've become eachother's date.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
I suppose some of the blame lies with me,
too. For putting such a strain between us.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: …A strain, huh?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Well… even so,
I have no intention whatsoever to drag her
down with me.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Regardless of how this might worsen things
between us,
it's no time to pull out a wedge we've driven
in. I've not given up yet… and,
more importantly, neither has she.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: …What should I do?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Greetings, Sakura Chiyono O-san.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
Do you have some spare time this afternoon?
I have a matter I'd like to speak with you
about.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
